UAE National Day countdown

Shows the days and hours until Eid Al Etihad and this year's official holiday days.

How many days left?

About UAE National Day

Eid Al Etihad marks the union of the United Arab Emirates on 2 December 1971; 2026 is the 55th anniversary.

Working on an official holiday earns extra pay or a substitute day; work it out on the public holidays page, and for all six countries see GCC public holidays.

Frequently asked questions

When is UAE National Day 2026?

Wednesday 2 December 2026, the 55th anniversary of the union on 2 December 1971.

How long is the National Day holiday in 2026?

Two days, Wednesday 2 and Thursday 3 December 2026, under Cabinet Resolution 27/2024 on official holidays, followed by the weekend.
